notes.note: Heading of the DHCP reservations section on the page of a reserved host.
Introduction of the DHCP reservations section on the host page.

segment.source: The reservation of an address follows the identity of its interface: the client identifier when the interface has one, else the MAC address.
segment.target: Reservationen för en adress följer gränssnittets identitet: klientidentifieraren om gränssnittet har en, annars MAC-adressen.

notes.note: Shown when the reserved host has no IPv4 address on a live interface.

segment.source: This host has no active or planned IPv4 address on an interface, so there is nothing to reserve.
segment.target: Värden har ingen aktiv eller planerad IPv4-adress på ett gränssnitt, så det finns inget att reservera.

notes.note: Column header: what the reservation is keyed by.
Column header: whether the DHCP server serves the reservation.
Column header: the lease on the address.
Before the client identifier a reservation is keyed by.
Before the MAC address a reservation is keyed by.
The interface has neither a MAC address nor a client identifier (IPAM-18).

segment.source: No MAC address or client identifier: no reservation
segment.target: Ingen MAC-adress eller klientidentifierare: ingen reservation

notes.note: No DHCP scope covers the address.

segment.source: No DHCP scope serves this network

notes.note: Link to the DHCP scopes, shown to people who may change them.
The scope of the address is disabled.
The dhcp role does not run on this server.

segment.source: The dhcp role does not run on this server

notes.note: No lease on the address yet.

segment.source: No lease yet: the client has not asked since the reservation exists
segment.target: Inget lån ännu: klienten har inte frågat sedan reservationen fanns

notes.note: The lease on the address could not be read.

segment.source: The lease could not be read.

notes.note: When an active lease ends; {when} is a relative time such as in 3 hours.

Shown when the host has IPv6 addresses.

segment.source: IPv6 addresses get no DHCP reservation yet; that comes in a later version.
segment.target: IPv6-adresser får ingen DHCP-reservation ännu; det kommer i en senare version.
